model.name: Nano Banana Pro
model.immutable_provider_version: Not exposed by endpoint; cannot pin internal weight revision.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: The seed for the random number generator.

aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: The aspect ratio of the generated image.

limit_generations.title: Limit Generations
limit_generations.description: Experimental parameter to limit the number of generations from each round of prompting to 1. Set to `True` to to disregard any instructions in the prompt regarding the number of images to generate.

sync_mode.title: Sync Mode
sync_mode.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI and the output data won't be available in the request history.

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.description: The resolution of the image to generate.

num_images.title: Number of Images
num_images.description: The number of images to generate.

enable_web_search.title: Enable Web Search
enable_web_search.description: Enable web search for the image generation task. This will allow the model to use the latest information from the web to generate the image.

output_format.title: Output Format
output_format.description: The format of the generated image.

system_prompt.title: System Prompt
system_prompt.description: Optional system instruction that steers the model's persona and output style across the request. Leave blank to omit; when provided, it is sent as the system instruction to Gemini (or as a system message on OpenAI-compatible providers).

prompt.title: Prompt
examples: An action shot of a black lab swimming in an inground suburban swimming pool. The camera is placed meticulously on the water line, dividing the image in half, revealing both the dogs head above water holding a tennis ball in it's mouth, and it's paws paddling underwater.
prompt.description: The text prompt to generate an image from.

safety_tolerance.title: Safety Tolerance
safety_tolerance.description: The safety tolerance level for content moderation. 1 is the most strict (blocks most content), 6 is the least strict.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

description.title: Description
description.description: The description of the generated images.

pricing.limitations: This is a rate × quantity estimate, not a configured quote or final charge. The pricing API does not expose configuration-specific rules, minimum charges, rounding, or input-media measurements. Audio, resolution, quality and provider rules may change the final cost. It does not check balance or permission and does not block generation.

account.message: No billing restriction was reported for this fal account. Check model pricing before generating; the API checks whether each job is allowed and affordable.

selection.limitations: Recommendation initially returned needs_input solely for quantity_unavailable. Resolved with num_images=1, estimate_cost, and model page configuration pricing. Initial 3D misrouting discarded. Semantic routing warning was a non-error advisory; exact schema and keyword catalog remain available. No seam switch. 512 delivery requires documented 1K-to-512 resampling.
